goal: Freeze a deterministic CPU-only event/resource engine with exact rational clocks, fail-closed resource semantics and portable checkpoints.
scope: C++20 sole scheduling core and thin C/Python bindings
exact rational clock edge and receiver-edge ceiling
dependency, resource, queue and bridge semantics
capacity conservation, deadlock and Zeno detection
canonical checkpoint serialization and hash-bound restore
non_goals: Phase 4 GPU compute, memory, copy or interconnect performance model
runtime adapter or live trace collection
assumptions: Engine inputs have already passed the frozen Phase 2 Canonical IR validator.
Canonical string keys are NFC-normalized before crossing the trusted low-level engine boundary.
Event priorities already match the Phase 0 registry because Phase 2 validate_events is the authoritative input gate.
unknowns: production trace scale and partition pressure
alternative_designs: Python scheduling core rejected because it would create a second scheduler.
Rounded-period accumulation rejected because it creates clock drift.
Heap-memory checkpoint rejected because it is not portable or canonical.
risks: The low-level C API is a trusted adapter boundary and does not independently repeat every Phase 2 schema check.
Python exposes execution smoke coverage; full checkpoint control remains in the authoritative C++ API.
ASAN leak detection is disabled only for the Python interpreter process because interpreter-owned allocations are not Phase 3 leaks; C++ leak detection remains enabled.
validation_method: ASAN and UBSAN C++ execution with leak detection
ASAN and UBSAN Python ctypes smoke
CDC, capacity, deadlock, Zeno and unsupported-boundary negative tests
checkpoint equivalence at every event boundary
full-range checked resource conservation and fresh-waiter rejection
acceptance_criteria: normal C++ and Python CTest PASS
three roles GO on one ledger with empty blockers
owner_decisions: Phase 2 GO authorizes Phase 3 CPU-only implementation.
Push is permitted after each completed phase.
next_legal_action: After same-hash GO, begin Phase 4 single-discrete-GPU resource model implementation using CPU synthetic replay only.
forbidden_actions: modification or reinterpretation of frozen G3/S4 evidence
